notes.title: Demo drops September 5th for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Demo arriving September 5!


Get ready to dive into an intense preview of the Just Climb experience starting September 5, 2025.

With vertical challenges, tension, and exploration, this demo will plunge you right into the climb... but beware, every hold counts!


See you at Steam Next Fest – October 13 to 20


Just Climb will officially participate in Steam Next Fest from October 13 to 20, 2025!

A unique opportunity to test the game, watch live gameplay, ask questions, and be part of the adventure.

Don’t miss this key moment to support indie games shaking up the gaming scene!


Support the project and join the community


✨ Add the game to your Steam wishlist

🔔 Hit “Follow” to stay updated on future announcements and support

💬 Join the Discord community to chat, share feedback, and never miss a thing

🐦 Follow our Twitter/X for behind-the-scenes, exclusive info, and a little virtual sweat!



🕵️‍♂️ One last tip for the curious: rumor has it the computer desktop… hides some mysterious secrets. (Only at the game’s release on October 31)

notes.title: Just Climb hit 300+ wishlists – thank you all so much! 🙏
notes.content:
A huge thank you to all of you for your support! 🙏


Thanks to your feedback, I’ve gathered lots of great ideas and will keep improving the game.

Every wishlist and follow counts — they help make Just Climb even better!


🎮 The demo is just around the corner!


Pssst... The demo will be available on September 5th, 2025 😉



Feel free to share the game with others and keep sending your feedback — whether it's on the forums, Discord, or social media. It really helps a lot! 🚀
